description: Use this when the user wants to withdraw an invitation that has not been accepted yet. Returns which invitation was cancelled; the link in its email stops working and nobody is emailed. Owners and admins only. Not for removing someone who already joined: that is done in the dashboard, and the result gives the link.

invitation.description: The invitation's id (from list_team) or the invited email address.

name: revoke_invitation
title: Cancel an invitation
